mechanism: Perphenazine may increase primaquine's bone marrow suppression risk and both drugs can cause photosensitivity; primaquine's metabolism via CYP3A4/2D6 may be affected by perphenazine's CYP2D6 inhibition.
action: Monitor complete blood count regularly; counsel on photosensitivity precautions and advise baseline G6PD testing before primaquine initiation; consider alternative antipsychotic if severe hematologic concerns.
